learning_outcomes.text: Students know the tasks of an engineering design department in a company and the phases it has to process in the development process from task definition to product realization.
They master the procedure for creating requirement specifications and the most important methods for generating solution variants and evaluating them.

syllabus_topics: Position of the design department in the company
Introduction to systems theory: system definition, transformations, relationships, function, transfer to technical systems, technical-physical effects
Fundamentals of methodical approach: thought structures, intuitive and discursive thinking, decision-making behavior
Discursive thinking methods: analysis, abstraction, synthesis, negation, systematization
Methods for solution search: conventional, intuitive and discursively shaped methods
Selection and evaluation methods: selection list, pairwise comparison, utility value analysis
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for the award of credit points is a passed module exam. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
bibliography: Bender, B., Gericke, K.: Pahl/Beitz Konstruktionslehre – Methoden und Anwendung erfolgreicher Produktentwicklung, Springer Verlag (ebook 978-3-662-57303-7)
